cards.sentence: 你好！很高兴认识你。 = Hello! Nice to meet you.
cards.etymology: 你 (nǐ) = you; 好 (hǎo) = good

cards.sentence: 我是学生。 = I am a student.
cards.etymology: 学 (xué) = to study; 生 (shēng) = person, to be born

cards.sentence: 她是我的老师。 = She is my teacher.
cards.etymology: 老 (lǎo) = experienced; 师 (shī) = teacher, master

cards.sentence: 我住在中国。 = I live in China.
cards.etymology: 中 (zhōng) = middle; 国 (guó) = country

cards.sentence: 我学习中文。 = I study Chinese.
cards.etymology: 中 (zhōng) = China; 文 (wén) = writing, language

cards.sentence: 他是我的朋友。 = He is my friend.
cards.etymology: 朋 (péng) = companion; 友 (yǒu) = friend

cards.sentence: 学校在这里。 = The school is here.
cards.etymology: 学 (xué) = to study; 校 (xiào) = school

cards.sentence: 我爱我的家人。 = I love my family.
cards.etymology: 家 (jiā) = home, family; 人 (rén) = person

cards.sentence: 今天天气很好。 = The weather is nice today.
cards.etymology: 今 (jīn) = current; 天 (tiān) = day, sky

cards.sentence: 明天见！ = See you tomorrow!
cards.etymology: 明 (míng) = next, bright; 天 (tiān) = day, sky

cards.sentence: 我们一起吃饭吧。 = Let's eat together.
cards.etymology: 吃 (chī) = to eat; 饭 (fàn) = cooked rice, meal

cards.sentence: 请多喝水。 = Please drink plenty of water.
cards.etymology: 喝 (hē) = to drink; 水 (shuǐ) = water

cards.sentence: 我们坐火车去。 = We are going by train.
cards.etymology: 火 (huǒ) = fire; 车 (chē) = vehicle

cards.sentence: 再见，明天见。 = Goodbye, see you tomorrow.
cards.etymology: 再 (zài) = again; 见 (jiàn) = to see

cards.sentence: 我的手机在这里。 = My phone is here.
cards.etymology: 手 (shǒu) = hand; 机 (jī) = device, machine

cards.sentence: 今天天气很好。 = The weather is nice today.
cards.etymology: 天 (tiān) = sky, day; 气 (qì) = air, atmosphere

cards.sentence: 我马上回来。 = I'll be right back.
cards.etymology: 马 (mǎ) = horse; 上 (shàng) = up, above

cards.sentence: 我的电脑在桌子上。 = My computer is on the desk.
cards.etymology: 电 (diàn) = electricity; 脑 (nǎo) = brain

cards.sentence: 我在这里工作。 = I work here.
cards.etymology: 工 (gōng) = labor, work; 作 (zuò) = to do, to make

cards.sentence: 谢谢你的帮助。 = Thank you for your help.
cards.etymology: 谢 (xiè) = to thank; repeated 谢 adds emphasis
